mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_sessions (user_id, title, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, title, created_at, updated_at FROM chat_sessions WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_sessions WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_sessions SET title = #{title}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE chat_sessions SET updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
